summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by OBOOK Holdings Inc., a foreign private issuer, disclosing a commercial integration between OwlTing Group (NASDAQ: OWLS) and Saber Money for cross-border payment services into India, Eurozone, and UK. The filing discusses enterprise payment infrastructure, transaction-based fees, and market context on India's export economy. It contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is an ordinary business development announcement that does not trigger any special-situations category.
